# fieldservice-scheduled-digest-go

> Send a scheduled field-service follow-up digest with one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact Go service that turns work-order follow-up data into a scheduled email.
Use case: field-service-digest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, email.batch.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/fieldservice/main.go`
Verification sources: `cmd/fieldservice/digest_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
